prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Choose Personality"]
1: ["How to Interact With Your Pet", "Your pet lives on your desktop screen! Here are 3 quick controls to get started.", "Drag to move anywhere on your screen", "Right-click pet to hide or open settings", "Click pet anytime to chat or feed", "Got It, Let's Play!"]
2: ["Choose Your Pet Journey", "Scroll to pick between instant companionship or custom AI pet creation.", "Quick Adoption (Ready Immediately)", "Custom Creator (Upload Photo)"]
3: ["Hatching Your Desktop Companion...", "Your pet is getting ready to move onto your desktop screen.", "Preparing desktop habitat..."]
4: ["Save & Protect Your Pet", "Create or sign in to your account so your pet's memory, items, and progress are securely backed up in the cloud.", "Your pet will stay safely linked to this account whenever you open the app."]
5: ["Use clear, front-facing photos with good lighting for the best pet generation result.", "Tip: Well-lit photos without shadows produce realistic 3D pets!"]
6: ["Step 1: Generating pet graphics", "Step 2: Calibrating desktop overlay"]
7: ["Your Pet Arrived with a Gift!", "Welcome your pet to the desktop to claim your free Starter Toy Box.", "Gift Unlocked: Starter Toy Bundle"]
8: ["Feel free to minimize! We'll send a system alert as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop."]
9: ["How Would You Like to Adopt?", "Select an instant ready-to-play pet or build a custom companion from your own photo.", "Instant adoption lets you play right away!"]
